narr: A shortwave moved into the Lower Mississippi Valley triggering numerous showers and thunderstorms across Arkansas during the morning hours of April 13, 2022. Storms eventually organized into a line that swept across the Mid-South. A strong low-level jet, large amounts of wind shear, and moderate amounts of instability supported severe thunderstorms across the Mid-South. Large hail, damaging wind and tornadoes were the result. Locally heavy rain also caused flooding.
ev: Northbound lanes of Highway 51 between Atoka and Brighton closed due to flooding.
Flooding on North Parkway under the North Watkins overpass.
Significant flooding at Macon Road and Jackson Avenue. Several cars were stalled in 2-3 feet of water.
